items.desc: For nearly two decades, the Nepali Congress president has been one of Nepal’s most effective political speakers. As he prepares to lead the party, his greatest strength becomes his biggest test.

items.title: Keep kites, balloons and drones away from Kathmandu airport, authorities warn
items.desc: Aviation authorities say objects entering flight paths could threaten aircraft taking off and landing.

items.title: Nepali Congress to add senior and woman vice-presidents
items.desc: Central committee also decides to increase general secretaries to three and joint general secretaries to 13.

items.title: Two workers killed as earth collapses during road work in Baglung
items.desc: Three workers were buried while building a road in Nisikhola, days after a landslide killed five people in the same area.

items.title: Yemeni government launches offensive to seize all areas from Iran-backed Houthis
items.desc: Saudi-backed government forces vow to fight until Yemen is “liberated” as the Houthis hold Sanaa and much of the northwest and expand their control along the Red Sea coastline.

items.title: Gas shortages push Nepali households towards electric stoves
items.desc: Imports of induction and infrared cookers have surged as unreliable LPG supplies and rising prices drive consumers to alternative cooking options.

items.title: Budget-friendly places for Nepali students in Kuala Lumpur
items.desc: These five areas offer students different ways to balance affordable rent, convenient commutes and everyday amenities.

items.title: Collared kingfisher sighted in Dhanusha, a first for Nepal
items.desc: The bird was photographed at a farm in Janakpur. This takes Nepal’s recorded bird species tally to 904.

items.title: Journalist Kunda Dixit on a young, fragile Himalayas—and the risks Nepal is ignoring
items.desc: Dixit, who has written about climate and environment for decades, says Nepal must rethink how it builds and plans for disasters in a rapidly changing mountain landscape.

items.title: Nepal, India move to digitise cross-border vehicle permits
items.desc: Joint task force will streamline permit issuance, fees, and border procedures as neighbours seek to ease movement of private and non-regular passenger vehicles.

items.title: Parties pledge cooperation on democracy, constitution and national interest at Congress convention
items.desc: Nepali Congress president Gagan Thapa calls for a break with the politics of recurring power struggles, while opposition leaders question the government’s approach to Parliament and democracy.

items.title: Prioritise economic recovery and job accessibility for flood-affected communities
items.desc: While disasters require immediate rescue and relief, enabling flood survivors to access income opportunities is equally vital.

items.title: Shah went to the UN to speak for Nepal, then left before he could make the most of it
items.desc: Nepal’s moment of global sympathy needed a prime minister willing to work the rooms. Shah chose to fly home instead.

items.title: Gagan Thapa on giving Congress a new generation and a new purpose
items.desc: As he seeks re-election, the Nepali Congress president outlines his vision for a party that goes beyond elections and power to become a broader social movement.

items.title: A Dom boy’s long road to becoming a doctor
items.desc: Dinesh Kumar Marik faced caste discrimination and financial hardship at every stage of his education. He has now passed his medical licensing exam on his first attempt.

items.title: Thapa says Congress must bridge political divides and rebuild public trust
items.desc: Congress president calls for a more open party and Parliament, criticises the revolving door of power and urges cooperation to address Nepal’s economic and political challenges.

items.title: Fourteen lawmakers missed ten or more consecutive parliamentary meetings
items.desc: Former prime minister Pushpa Kamal Dahal topped the list with 24 consecutive absences during the second session of the newly elected House of Representatives.

items.title: Rabi Lamichhane vows continued cooperation for democracy and change
items.desc: RSP chair says his party will work with other political forces to uphold democratic values, while Pushpa Kamal Dahal backs Gagan Thapa’s leadership and calls for broader political cooperation.

items.title: Leaders call for generational change, national consensus at Congress convention
items.desc: Former prime minister Baburam Bhattarai says established parties must learn from Gen Z’s revolt and give younger leaders greater responsibility.

items.title: Foreign parties send greetings as Congress kicks off general convention
items.desc: Political parties from India, Bangladesh, China and the UK, along with international organisations, express support for Nepal and call for stronger ties and regional cooperation.

items.title: Nepali Congress 15th general convention kicks off in Kathmandu
items.desc: Party President Gagan Thapa inaugurates the three-day gathering by laying garlands on portraits of former presidents and watering a sapling.

items.title: Gagan Thapa calls for Congress reset, tougher oversight of government
items.desc: The Congress chief’s political report set to be presented at the party convention calls for an end to electoral alliances, cleaner candidate selection, and a reckoning with the Gen Z protests.

items.title: Thousands head to Khula Manch for Nepali Congress convention
items.desc: More than 7,700 delegates are gathering in Kathmandu for the opening of the party’s 15th general convention, with leadership elections set for later this week

items.title: Tens of thousands protest across Spain over housing crisis
items.desc: Tens of thousands take to the streets after parliament rejects measures to ease soaring rents, evictions and a broader housing shortage.

items.title: Police shoot and arrest man suspected of abducting 10-year-old girl
items.desc: The girl was rescued unharmed after nearly 40 hours, while the suspect was found hiding in a paddy field and shot in the leg when he resisted arrest.

items.title: Monsoon pulls out as forecast points to a drier Dashain
items.desc: Most of Nepal could see the monsoon recede within days, with no major weather system currently expected during the main Dashain holidays.

items.title: Why was Deepak Bhatta moved to Sindhupalchok prison?
items.desc: Officials say the transfer was routine, but a prison department source says concerns over Bhatta’s alleged efforts to influence proceedings from inside Nakkhu may have prompted the move.

items.title: Housing bill proposes cash grants, tougher penalties for building violations
items.desc: Extremely poor families could receive at least Rs75,000 in federal and provincial support to build their first home, while buildings over 50 years old would face mandatory safety assessments.

items.title: Experts, leaders urge Congress to adopt a sharper foreign policy
items.desc: They call for a pragmatic approach to relations with India, China and other major powers, with greater focus on economic diplomacy and strategic autonomy.
